mapper.sql: CASE WHEN ${alias}stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_current, -- 本期标志(0/1) CASE WHEN ${alias}stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_last -- 同期标志(0/1)
CASE WHEN ${alias}stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} THEN ADD_MONTHS(${alias}stat_date, 12) ELSE ${alias}stat_date END
CASE WHEN NVL(${last}, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((${cur} - ${last}) / ${last} * 100, 0) END
mapper.select: SELECT v.totalDischargeCount, -- 出院人次(本期) AS totalDischargeCompare, -- 出院人次同比% v.dischargedCount, -- 已结算人次(本期) AS dischargedCompare, -- 已结算人次同比% v.notDischargedCount, -- 未结算人次(本期) AS notDischargedCompare, -- 未结算人次同比% NVL(m.settlementAmount, 0) AS settlementAmount, -- 结算金额(本期) AS settlementAmountCompare -- 结算金额同比% FROM ( SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} THEN 1 END) AS totalDischargeCount, -- 出院人次(本期) COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} THEN 1 END) AS totalDischargeLast, -- 出院人次(同期) COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND settle_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS dischargedCount, -- 已结算人次(本期) COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} AND settle_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS dischargedLast, -- 已结算人次(同期) COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND settle_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS notDischargedCount, -- 未结算人次(本期) COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} AND settle_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS notDischargedLast -- 未结算人次(同期) FROM tr_disch_settle_visit WHERE () ) v, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} THEN charges ELSE 0 END), 0) AS settlementAmount, -- 结算金额(本期) NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} THEN charges ELSE 0 END), 0) AS settlementAmountLast -- 结算金额(同期) FROM tr_settle_master WHERE () ) m

SELECT
TO_CHAR(v.itemDate, 'YYYY-MM') TO_CHAR(v.itemDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", -- 日期 NVL(v.totalCurrent, 0) AS totalCurrent, -- 出院人次(本期) NVL(v.totalLast, 0) AS totalLast, -- 出院人次(同期) AS totalCompare, -- 出院人次同比% NVL(v.dischargedCurrent, 0) AS dischargedCurrent, -- 已结算人次(本期) NVL(v.dischargedLast, 0) AS dischargedLast, -- 已结算人次(同期) AS dischargedCompare, -- 已结算人次同比% NVL(v.notDischargedCurrent, 0) AS notDischargedCurrent, -- 未结算人次(本期) NVL(v.notDischargedLast, 0) AS notDischargedLast, -- 未结算人次(同期) AS notDischargedCompare, -- 未结算人次同比% NVL(m.amountCurrent, 0) AS amountCurrent, -- 结算金额(本期) NVL(m.amountLast, 0) AS amountLast, -- 结算金额(同期) AS amountCompare -- 结算金额同比% FROM ( SELECT AS itemDate, -- 日期轴 COUNT(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 THEN 1 END) AS totalCurrent, -- 出院人次(本期) COUNT(CASE WHEN in_last = 1 THEN 1 END) AS totalLast, -- 出院人次(同期) COUNT(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 AND settle_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS dischargedCurrent, -- 已结算人次(本期) COUNT(CASE WHEN in_last = 1 AND settle_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS dischargedLast, -- 已结算人次(同期) COUNT(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 AND settle_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS notDischargedCurrent, -- 未结算人次(本期) COUNT(CASE WHEN in_last = 1 AND settle_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS notDischargedLast -- 未结算人次(同期) FROM ( SELECT settle_status, -- 结算状态(1已结算 2未结算) AS axis_date, -- 日期轴(同期平移+12月)
FROM tr_disch_settle_visit WHERE () ) GROUP BY ) v LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AS itemDate, -- 日期轴 SUM(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 THEN charges ELSE 0 END) AS amountCurrent, -- 结算金额(本期) SUM(CASE WHEN in_last = 1 THEN charges ELSE 0 END) AS amountLast -- 结算金额(同期) FROM ( SELECT charges, -- 结算金额 AS axis_date, -- 日期轴(同期平移+12月)
FROM tr_settle_master WHERE () ) GROUP BY ) m ON m.itemDate = v.itemDate ORDER BY v.itemDate

SELECT channel AS name, -- 渠道(窗口/自助机) COUNT(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 THEN 1 END) AS value, -- 本期人次 NVL(
, 0) AS compare -- 同比% FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN operator_no = '9111' THEN '自助机' ELSE '窗口' END AS channel, -- 渠道(9111=自助机)
FROM tr_settle_master WHERE () ) GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel

SELECT charge_type AS name, -- 结算费别 COUNT(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 THEN 1 END) AS value, -- 本期人次 NVL(
, 0) AS compare -- 同比% FROM ( SELECT charge_type, -- 结算费别
FROM tr_settle_master WHERE charge_type IS NOT NULL AND () ) GROUP BY charge_type ORDER BY charge_type

SELECT money_type AS name, -- 支付方式 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN in_current = 1 THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value, -- 本期收金额 NVL(
, 0) AS compare -- 同比% FROM ( SELECT money_type, -- 支付方式 payment_amount, -- 支付金额(收)
FROM tr_settle_payments WHERE money_type IS NOT NULL AND () ) GROUP BY money_type ORDER BY money_type

SELECT charge_type AS name, -- 结算费别 COUNT(1) AS value, -- 本期人次 0 AS compare -- 同比(恒0) FROM tr_settle_master WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND charge_type IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN operator_no = '9111' THEN '自助机' ELSE '窗口' END = #{channel} GROUP BY charge_type ORDER BY charge_type
